editorial:
The Undersea Kingdom is a 12-chapter Republic Pictures serial released on 30 May 1936. Ray "Crash" Corrigan plays Crash Corrigan, an athlete and Navy lieutenant. Following a suspicious earthquake and a series of detected signals, Professor Norton leads an expedition in his rocket submarine to the suspected location of Atlantis (per Wikipedia).

The print's status is not settled. A partial read of the 1963 and 1964 Catalog of Copyright Entries, where renewals filed in those years are recorded, found no Undersea Kingdom entry. That read was incomplete and relied on imperfect OCR. It did not cover entries under a series title or under Republic Pictures Corp. as claimant. Finish a full search of both volumes before relying on the print. The Internet Archive's main copy is described as colorized, and any colorization may be protected separately, but this has not been established.
